items.item_text: Knowledge in oncology and/or Board Certification preferred
Pharm D. degree and current CA Pharmacy license
Experience in IV Medication Compounding preferred

You bring more than skill, knowledge, and expertise to your role as an allied health professional. You bring a deep passion for improving the lives of everyone around you. At UCLA Health, we’re committed to fostering a working environment where you are supported and empowered to be your best. You’ll love it here!

Reporting to the Pharmacy supervisor and Pharmacy Research Manager, you will perform various pharmacist functions pertaining to investigational drugs and clinical research. Some of these functions include:
Conduct all protocol-related duties including: study set-up, drug dispensation, study monitoring, close-out activities
Perform medication dispensing activities to deliver outstanding patient care
Support the Pharmacy Supervisor in ensuring compliance to rules, policies and regulations
Cultivate and model professional, collaborative relationship with pharmacy staff, medical professionals, support, and administrative staff
Demonstrate effective problem-solving and organizational skills
Adapt to the challenges of a rapidly changing health care environment
Advance a patient-centric focus to treat illness with integrity, innovation, and commitment

At UCLA Health, passionate clinicians in a wide range of disciplines have enabled us to become a world-renowned health system with four award-winning hospitals and more than 290 community clinics throughout Southern California. We’re also home to the world-class medical research and clinical education capabilities of the David Geffen School of Medicine. If you’re looking to experience greater challenge and fulfillment in your career, come to UCLA Health.
Schedule: Varied shifts, depending on department needs (Monday-Friday). Required to have the ability to travel to multiple work sites within UCLA Health
